items.title: Is EOG Resources (EOG) Trading At A Discount To Its Cash Flow?

EOG Resources has returned 106.6% over 5 years, which puts real pressure on the idea that its current valuation still lines up with the cash it can produce. items.summary: EOG Resources (EOG) has drawn fresh attention after recent trading left the shares down about 4.6% on the day and roughly 3.5% lower over the past week, despite gains over the past month.
